discovery_expectations.text: Tests email validation edge cases (missing domain, multiple @, no @ at all)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when email has no @ symbol'; test.skip 'preserves the full address when email contains multiple @ symbols - BUG' documents multiple-@ truncation; also 'passes validation for email with only @ present' documents permissive check

discovery_expectations.text: Tests age with NaN or Infinity values bypassing the range check
discovery_expectations.evidence: test.skip 'returns error for NaN age - BUG': NaN bypasses age < 0 || age > 150 check; 'returns error for Infinity age' and 'returns error for -Infinity age' — Infinity is caught (passes correctly)

discovery_expectations.text: Tests normalizeEmail with string that has no @ (destructuring crash)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test.skip 'does not crash when email has no @ symbol - BUG': normalizeEmail('notanemail') throws TypeError from undefined.toLowerCase()

discovery_expectations.text: Tests whitespace-only name passes trim check
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns error when name is whitespace only': name='   ' triggers 'Name is required' error; also 'returns error when name is tab and newline whitespace only'

discovery_expectations.text: Tests names with special characters (accents, apostrophes, unicode)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns valid for name with apostrophe and hyphen': name="O'Brien-Smith"; test 'returns valid for name with accented characters': name='Ångström'; plus Chinese and Arabic name tests in bugmagnet session

discovery_expectations.text: Tests tags as empty array vs undefined
discovery_expectations.evidence: test 'returns valid for empty tags array' (validateUser); test.skip 'shows none for empty tags array instead of blank bracket - BUG': formatUserDisplay with tags=[] produces '[Tags: ]' not '[Tags: none]'

format_expectations.text: Documents at least one discovered bug as a skipped test with BUG notation
format_expectations.evidence: test.skip('returns error for NaN age - BUG'), test.skip('does not crash when email has no @ symbol - BUG'), test.skip('does not crash when email is empty string - BUG'), test.skip('preserves the full address when email contains multiple @ symbols - BUG'), test.skip('shows none for empty tags array instead of blank bracket - BUG') — all use test.skip + BUG in name

quality_expectations.text: Generated tests compile and run without syntax errors
quality_expectations.evidence: All tests use standard vitest syntax (describe/test/expect) with correct imports; no syntax errors in static analysis

quality_expectations.text: Skipped BUG tests actually fail when unskipped (bug is real, not a false positive)
quality_expectations.evidence: NaN age bug is real: NaN < 0 and NaN > 150 both return false in JS; normalizeEmail crash on no-@ is real: domain=undefined, undefined.toLowerCase() throws TypeError; empty tags [] bug is real: [].join() returns '' which ?? 'none' does not replace
